    Our Story

    Our Story

    Loopy was founded in 2012 by three brothers and their dad with one goal: to build the best product possible to StoptheDrop®️. After our dad cracked his phone by refusing a bulky case, we asked ourselves why drop it in the first place? 

    Being family-owned, we’ve spent over a decade obsessed with treating our customers exactly how we’d want to be treated.  We truly hope you love what we’ve made, and with thousands of 5-star reviews that include the word "love," we hope you will too.

    Learn More

    It's time to StoptheDrop®

    In the USA, a phone breaks every 2 seconds (Source: SquareTrade), and screen repairs can cost upwards of $200!  With Loopy®, you'll not only StoptheDrop®, but you'll also make your phone far more functional and comfortable to use than you ever imagined.
